title: BARx CrossFit

services.name: Drop in
services.desc: Whether you are in town for a visit or looking for a new CrossFit home come drop into any of our classes. Weekly drop in rates available. Email info@barxcrossfit.com for more

explain.meaning: Pay for a single class, with no membership or package.

blurb: BARx CrossFit is a gym where friends can work out and have fun located in Kirkwood, Missouri. At BARx fun and friends has remained our top priority. We believe it is our members and coaches that make BARx truly special. Whether you’re new to CrossFit or a veteran competitor, you’ll find a warm welcome at BARx CrossFit.
